system.biography:
A soldier in its true form — a roughly man-sized chitin-armoured ant-horror that exists to protect the Queen. Aggressive, fearless, terrifying.

Armour 3/3 — Force ×1, not 2×Force. The doubled figure was a Double Exposure assumption; doubling would make every True Form twice as tough as printed.

Paralyzing Touch and Venom are easy to lose — OCR truncates the Powers line, and they only appear on the render.

Vulnerability to insecticide is the intended route to winning the climax.

Printed identically at p.38 and p.51 — a duplicate printing, not two variants. Replaces 'Soldier Ant Spirit (True Form, Force 4)'.

Manual rules the sheet does not enforce. Powers and Weaknesses are not fields on the NPC data model, so they live here as prose. Switching these to spirit actors would be worse — SpiritData.prepareDerivedData recomputes attributes from Force and would overwrite the printed table this whole audit exists to restore.

Astral: add +5 Initiative when acting astrally (the printed Reaction shows this as the bracketed second value). It is deliberately NOT baked into reaction, which would also inflate dodge and defence.

Attack: 9M Physical + Special (printed SR1 7M2, converted by p.283 method B — no SR2 item is an ant's mandibles, so the staging digit folds into Power).

Powers: Enhanced Senses (Smell), Manifestation, Paralyzing Touch, Venom.
Weaknesses: Reduced Senses (Sight), Vulnerability (Insecticide).

Queen Euphoria p.51, transcribed from a 300 dpi render.
